changes: Restore idle OrbitControls wheel and pinch zoom while using drag-only camera pointer capture; enable high-resolution two-finger trackpad panning without stealing gizmo movement.
Do not jump camera to selected objects; retain explicit numpad camera views and selected-object zoom.
Add Scene/Robot keyboard-control toggle and chooser of controllable robots to avoid trapping scene navigation after robot selection.
Compact object Position, Rotation and Scale into one accessible XYZ row per vector, with proportional scaling toggle and logarithmic 0.01x–1000x range.
Place Physics and Collider side by side; use a dark, unified friction/bounciness property selector with shared value input and slider.
Make Add Object a compact single-column list with fixed drag/search header and left-aligned icon/action rows.
Add room-user and robot @mention completion in the message composer, with keyboard navigation and full-name insertion.
Bring selected, newly opened and actively dragged windows to the front while leaving modal settings and galleries on top.
Add new regression tests for camera orbit, two-finger trackpad pan, transform scale, mentions, UI layout, menu and window focus.
Fix blank white Settings roundel by using a dedicated light cog asset and removing an icon-inverting filter from its painted background across button modes.
Render crisp 416x544 WebP avatar portrait thumbnails with portrait camera framing, balanced lighting and a visible dark backdrop rather than stretching tiny landscape JPEGs.
Persist avatar thumbnails in browser CacheStorage with a memory fallback, avoiding repeated GLB downloads and GPU rendering when the avatar library is reopened or the page is revisited.
Limit first-load avatar preview decoding to two concurrent jobs, reuse the single existing WebGL gallery renderer, and dispose short-lived GLB preview geometries/materials/textures.
Show built-in avatar cards without waiting for the authenticated uploaded-avatar API, and add four new thumbnail/cache/UI regression tests.
Rebuild realm gallery as image-first tiles with name overlay, live participant count and round avatar thumbnails; remove redundant card icons, wrap-free labels and oval header pills.
Add authenticated realm renaming and protected double-confirmation deletion with owner/admin authorization, active-participant guard and persistent SQLite owner migration.
Use one reusable WebGL preview renderer for Assets and Avatars, lazy sequential thumbnails and one on-demand cached room preview to reduce context-loss risk.
Replace redundant Hide chat and chat-panel Close controls with a reliable Overlay → Window → Hidden → Overlay cycle on the persistent bottom-left chat mode button.

Add browser-local settings for borderless controls, disabled interface shadows, backdrop blur and opt-out object-deletion confirmation; require confirmation across object list, Properties and keyboard.
Remove unused sceneModelPath text and unconfigured AI model selector, associate key fields with forms, add favicon and keep navigation/button labels on one line.
Compact Properties XYZ inputs while retaining full-width context slider and reset alignment; enlarge accepted server-side transforms for big scenes.
Make scene file-drop overlay explicitly cancellable, dismiss on Escape, blur, drag exit, drop and stale OS drag state.
Show the release log only for newly unviewed published versions; move Dev log control into top-right navigation between map and settings.
Replace the realm dropdown with a navigable realm-card gallery, locally captured room thumbnails and Create empty realm action.
Remove obsolete mobile More button; keep icon-only labels consistent, use a blank accessible composer drag handle and a webcam-shaped icon.
Hide unconfigured Meta model chooser; standardize close buttons and show Map, Settings and Profile labels in icon+text mode.
Support per-robot local Brain trace debugging from Properties and Brains, plus global debugging from Chat & sound Settings.
Automatically save per-room World Settings whenever fog, grid, floor, sky, background, view distance or editing permissions change; no Save or Preview action required.
Keep live appearance edits when closing World Settings and immediately flush outstanding edits to the backend, including policy and physics changes.
Serialize rapid autosaves, preserve latest edits across concurrent responses, and keep a room-specific local draft on network or permission failures for retry on reopen, reconnect or reload.
Show compact saving, saved, or failed status directly under the World Settings header, and automatically persist an explicitly confirmed reset to defaults.
Add autosave lifecycle regression tests for save, failure/retry, room isolation and fast slider changes; verify mobile and desktop drawer layouts.
Add a shared Assets gallery after Avatars in World tools, browsing existing uploaded GLB/FBX models with searchable 3D previews and a new upload option.
Add Upload model and Assets swap actions directly in the Properties object-actions row for selected 3D models; preserve object identity, pose, scale and physics settings when replacing geometry.
Preflight replacement model loading, handle missing assets without deleting the previous model, and invalidate/rebuild Rapier collision shapes after replacement and scale edits.
Compute accurate scaled model collider bounds in local rigid-body axes so rotated objects no longer get inflated world-axis colliders.
Add tests for uploaded-asset validation, replacement persistence, collider scale and rotation geometry, and compact mobile/tablet/desktop Assets and Properties layouts.
Prevent idle mouse movement from rotating the scene by enabling OrbitControls only while an accepted mouse, pen, or touch gesture is pressed; preserve explicit wheel zoom.
Keep the transform gizmo and camera orbit mutually exclusive for the duration of a gesture; allow pointerup to reach OrbitControls after picking an object, without triggering floor navigation.
Stop orbit immediately on pointerup, pointercancel, pointer capture loss, browser blur, hidden tab, or a missed mouse release; recover stale Three.js OrbitControls pointer state.
Add pointer lifecycle regression tests for gizmo capture, multi-touch, mouse/pen release, lost focus, wheel zoom and stale pointer recovery.
Add a per-object transform lock/unlock icon directly before Delete in the Objects list, with a compact visual locked state and accessible button labels.
Prevent Move/Rotate/Scale gizmos, G/R/S hotkeys, XYZ value editing and transform resets while locked, preserving selection, other object settings and robot missions.
Save per-object transform locks in shared scenes, propagate them through object WebSocket patches and local room snapshots, and validate lock fields on the Flask backend.
Provide new lock/unlock SVGs and regression coverage for the editor controls, API persistence and mobile/desktop row layout.
Add persistent per-room appearance controls: enable/disable fog and grid, fog color/near/far, floor size/color, grid color, background color.
Add six sky types: solid, procedural gradient, sunset clouds, animated rainbow, stars and nebula, with adjustable colors, animation speed, intensity and star density.
Expand scene camera far clip, orbit range, inspector position slider, XR teleport region and ground movement to support very large rooms and imported objects.
Synchronize appearance across users by room-specific authenticated SQLite endpoints and live WebSocket events; preview locally and save explicitly.
Add frontend and backend regression coverage for validation, layout, room isolation, camera extents and effect modes.
Filter target-specific robot 180/360 head-camera scans to at most three relevant viewpoints, using scene camera geometry or SAM detections; discard empty scans before Muse and chat attachments.
Require concise target-location replies rather than frame-by-frame descriptions and preserve general room scans for broad questions.
Report zero verified targets without a Muse inference or fabricated location; protect empty-JPEG requests with saved-question, room, robot and target validation.
Keep only positive SAM frames in Brains visual-search gallery and avoid diagnosing the last empty frame with Muse; clarify robot arrival messages.
Add regression coverage for target parsing, camera view selection, zero matches, and unchanged deployment packaging.
Repair backend integration test expecting a four-direction SAM search after the vision search was expanded to eight directions.
Assert the actual eight-direction task-result response and include HTTP status/body on future mismatches.
Keep all v0.2.44 compact Properties, robot eyes, voice selection, and obstacle-aware navigation unchanged; advance release versions for the strict deployment watcher.
Browse local system voices filtered by spoken language, with device voice assignment per robot and automatic Polish detection.
Browse and paginate ElevenLabs account voices with reported verified languages and accents; reject known mismatched voice-language combinations.
Capture eight direction-labelled robot-eye JPEGs for a real 360-degree scan; capture an actual downward-tilted view for look-down commands.
Send the entire camera batch with conversation, personality, goals and memories in one Muse Spark request, displaying all captured frames in chat and Brains.

Enable opt-in proactive visual observation (five images, one model request) with short-lived single-use authorization and a multiuser cooldown; report grounded suggestions without unapproved movement.
Expand SAM scene-object search to eight directions and add regression checks for camera plans, voice matching, authorization and usage.
Make ElevenLabs voice generation failures visible and actionable; never silently replace cloud audio with a local browser voice.
Add authenticated ElevenLabs voice catalogue in Robot Brains, with named voice selection and a real synthesize/playback status.
Return sanitized provider errors for invalid API keys, inaccessible voices, insufficient quota, rate limiting and connectivity.
Protect voice cache against provider key changes; test provider audio and error mapping without sending real billable requests.
Correct valid robot voice previews that previously returned HTTP 400 because omitted rate/pitch fields were converted with float(None).
Use saved voice rate and pitch as preview defaults, while accepting independent optional overrides and preserving input validation.
Add backend integration regressions for speech preview defaults, individual overrides, and invalid values; preserve local and ElevenLabs robot voice options.
Restore always-visible CC microphone transcription toggle directly before Send in Messages.
Repair room caption delivery status and explicit offline/auth errors.
Prevent chat icon-mode styles from hiding CC state and verify published voice transcripts.
Convert Cybert and other robots’ natural-language turn/roll/walk/jump instructions into permission-checked scene commands instead of conversational-only replies.
Implement smooth turn-in-place and turn-then-walk missions with bounded distance, turn-speed setting, scene persistence, and actual movement completion events.
Route explicit named-object destinations such as chair1o to scene-based navigation, and leave ambiguous “that way” references for clarification.
Add backend command routing and actual-frame stepping regressions, keeping existing chat, vision, avatars, and multiplayer features.
Move the single webcam launcher to the top-right of the draggable Message composer header instead of the top navigation.
Keep the webcam button icon-only with accessible Open/Close labels, 28px desktop and 36px phone sizes, plus active indication.
Preserve robot walk, turn, strafe, jump and go-to/sit behaviour; add regression coverage for the control and movement paths.
Visual questions addressed to a robot now capture a fresh head-camera JPEG before Muse Spark responds; the exact frame is shared in chat.
Webcam is available directly in top navigation on desktop and mobile.
Front-facing 3D headshots can be saved for robot chat portraits and user profile photos.
Robot portrait references persist in scene data; existing conversation history shows robot portraits rather than user photos.
Server validates visual requests, room ownership, JPEG uploads and billing; failures never impersonate visual perception.
Restore scene orbit and orbit-follow gestures by making transparent chat overlays pass through mouse/touch events.
Re-enable OrbitControls at the start of canvas drags when transform gizmos are not active.
Remove orphaned minimized Objects and World tools panels from the upper-left corner; reopen World tools from an explicit navigation control.
Keep object list accessible through World tools and preserve normal interactions with actual chat bubbles and the composer.
Remove obsolete top-level Export chat and Admin buttons; keep intentional actions in Settings only, with no corner artifacts.
Fix camera profile photography with preview, reliable image capture, immediate round avatar update and explicit failures.
Record video-only webcam intros up to 15 seconds and convert the entire duration to a persistent animated GIF on the server.
Add Log out with server token revocation, WebSocket disconnection and browser session cleanup.
Add a top-right draggable, zoomable and minimizable live top-down minimap of robots, objects and camera.
Restore independent scene orbit and touch orbit with robot selected without forcing pointer lock; remove duplicate quick model import.
Keep Objects and World Tools minimized titles on one line; place minimize beside close and remove duplicate window-control glyphs.
Hide bulk checkboxes and delete commands behind Bulk; keep search and type filter compact and preserve ownership checks.
Use single-row X/Y/Z number inputs with one reset per transform; keep one contextual slider, and share one slider across robot movement, strafe and turning.
Make chat composer undock and drag by its header, with remembered position; add video and robot-view attachment icons.
Post robot-eye screenshots in shared chat as robot-authored images, with optional Muse visual description and usage.
Use room geometry, robot pose, time, objectives and memories to ground Jessica conversations; recognize unique short nicknames and offer opt-in rate-limited proactive questions.
Reissue the v0.2.30 Chat, CC, Objects and Webcam release under a newer semantic version so the existing deployment watcher accepts it; application functionality is unchanged.
Dock or freely drag and minimize the chat composer; anchor the overlay feed at the bottom with scroll-to-latest visibility checks and a readable vertical attachment menu.
Allow searching, filtering and bulk selecting/deleting scene objects by room permissions with confirmations and room-persisted object removal.
Bound browser speech-recognition retries, automatically fall back to configured Ubuntu Whisper when available, and reliably publish CC: transcripts or show specific errors.
Move opt-in webcam preview into a dedicated panel with independent Face, Hands and Voice waves toggles, and local camera-based gesture emoji responses.
Attach and send a selected robots actual head-camera JPEG directly in room chat through the existing authenticated media backend.
Widen World tools to 176px and keep labels on a single line; preserve small-screen layouts and avoid hidden controls showing through icon/button CSS overrides; add regression tests.
Restore WebXR feature detection: VR controls start hidden and only appear after an immersive-vr support check, including on expanded mobile navigation.
Remove duplicate Settings cog; keep profile initials or photo as the only profile graphic; use smaller, consistent panel close and minimize buttons.
Limit icon-and-text button labels to two lines with restrained navigation and object-panel dimensions, including at 200% UI size.
Replace nine permanent transform sliders and extra physics/light sliders with one context-sensitive range beneath the focused numeric input, retaining precise editing and individual reset buttons.
Shorten navigation, transform and save labels; preserve keyboard shortcuts through tooltips, and keep all previous Brains, chat, CC, physics and avatar functionality.
Fix macOS watcher integration-test failure: backend health expected version now defaults to the current package.json release version, not the previous release.
Unify Ubuntu backend install health checks to use the exported SOLVI_EXPECTED_VERSION and update the standalone fallback to v0.2.28.
Add release-consistency regression test comparing package, public release history, frontend banner, API health and Ubuntu installer version contracts.
Preserve v0.2.27 compact Settings, precision sliders, semantic SVG controls, static trimesh collision, and Add menu visibility behaviour without changes.
Add icon+description, description-only and icon-only UI modes with device-aware mobile default, preserving accessible button names and tooltips.
Use the supplied SVG Repo icon collection for semantic controls, including an original matching cube pictogram for the add menu.
Rebuild Settings with clear visual sections, populated colour theme preview cards, corrected coloured accent swatches and high-contrast themes.
Add persistent 50–200% interface scaling and system, sans, serif, rounded, monospace or installed-device font choices.
Make smartphone layout world-first: collapsed world tools, accessible More navigation and permanently visible CC/chat send controls with 44px touch targets.
Clarify CC microphone on/off states and delivery to room chat as CC: transcript; guard missing publisher and queue Whisper segments without silently dropping while busy.
Add regression tests for device modes, font input safety, contrast, icons and captions; retain robot Brains, Meta AI, multiplayer, and the unchanged release watcher contract.
Replace missing-object hardcoded dead end with four real head-camera SAM searches and raycast matches to scene geometry.
Log observable robot address, intent, Muse task plan, screenshot request, Meta usage, segmentation results, navigation and completion.
Add chat verbose robot trace, persisted task-completion replies and Brains trace with exact last JPEG shown.
Make robot identity collapsible; widen and resize Brains, enlarge images and diagnostics, and explain scenario AI explicitly.
Use real Sit clips when available and labelled approximate procedural seating fallback; preserve Ubuntu release watcher compatibility.
Add Muse Spark scene-description action for robot head-camera images and SAM 3.1 object bounding-box overlays with prompt and estimated-cost details.
Route typed chat and opt-in published CC captions to named robots, including unambiguous one-character name corrections.
Execute permission-checked, deterministic scene commands to approach named objects, walk short distances, stop and attempt real Sit animation clips.
Use saved scene labels and coordinates for robot navigation; missing targets/clips report limitations without claiming autonomous perception.
Preserve the existing macOS watcher, Ubuntu backend, avatar assets and previously released controls.
Fix SQLite chat history failure caused by a misquoted NULLIF empty-string literal in the messages query.
Add backend integration regression coverage for ordinary speaker names and persisted AI robot speaker overrides.
Preserve all v0.2.20 controls, camera modes, Robot Brains and Meta AI features without modifying the deployment watcher.
Bottom camera button cycles Free → Chase (smooth inertial trailing behind selected robot) → Orbit follow (camera tracks robot while preserving user-set orbit angle).
The follow camera tracks selected moving robots without stealing arrow-key locomotion or moving the XR headset camera.
OrbitControls drag updates the follow offset; numpad camera presets are respected; camera mode persists locally and sends no network traffic.
